# xmatters_device (Resource)

Create or update a device in xMatters. Provide fields in the request body that are common to all devices as well as fields that are specific to the type of device you want to create, for example, include the 'emailAddress' field when creating email devices and include the 'phoneNumber' field for phone, text (SMS), or public address devices.

Mobile app devices such as iPhone, iPad, and Android cannot be created using Terraform. These devices are added to a user's profile in xMatters automatically after they install the mobile app on their device and use it to log on to xMatters for the first time. However, once a mobile app device has been added to a user's profile it may be modified through Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
// Basic:
resource "xmatters_device" "basic_device" {
  // Required attributes
  device_type        = "EMAIL"
  name               = "Work Email"
  owner              = "481086d8-357a-4279-b7d5-d7dce48fcd12"
  priority_threshold = "MEDIUM"
  test_status        = "TESTED"
  timeframes = [
    {
      days                = ["MO", "WE", "FR"]
      duration_in_minutes = 5
      exclude_holidays    = true
      name                = "50/50 Shift"
      start_time          = "08:00"
    },
  ]
  // Required when device_type is EMAIL
  email_address = "mmcbride@your-company.org"
}

// Advanced:
resource "xmatters_device" "advanced_device" {
  // Required attributes
  device_type        = "EMAIL"
  name               = "Work Email"
  owner              = "481086d8-357a-4279-b7d5-d7dce48fcd12"
  priority_threshold = "MEDIUM"
  test_status        = "TESTED"
  timeframes = [
    {
      days                = ["MO", "WE", "FR"]
      duration_in_minutes = 5
      exclude_holidays    = true
      name                = "50/50 Shift"
      start_time          = "08:00"
    },
  ]
  // Required when device_type is EMAIL
  email_address = "mmcbride@your-company.org"
  // Optional attributes
  default_device   = true
  delay            = 15
  external_key     = "mmcbride-email"
  externally_owned = true
  status           = "ACTIVE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_type` (String) The type of device. Available options are: EMAIL, TEXT_PAGER, TEXT_PHONE, VOICE, VOICE_IVR
- `name` (String) The name of the device. Device names are configured uniquely for each company. For example, Work Phone, Work Email.
- `owner` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the user that owns the device.
- `priority_threshold` (String) The minimum priority of an alert for it to be delivered to this device. Available options are: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH.
- `test_status` (String) A code indicating whether the device has been tested or if testing is in progress. Available options are: TESTED, UNTESTED, PENDING, INVALID.
- `timeframes` (Attributes Set) A list of timeframes when xMatters may contact this device. If the ‘default_device’ parameter is set to ‘true’, the device may be contacted outside of the specified timeframes in certain situations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeframes))

### Optional

- `default_device` (Boolean) If 'true', the device can receive notifications when the user has no other active devices. Available values are: true, false.
- `delay` (Number) The number of minutes to wait for a response on this device before contacting the next device.
- `email_address` (String) The email address of the device. Required when the 'device_Type' is EMAIL. For example. someone@example.com
- `external_key` (String) Unique identifier of a resource in an external system.
- `externally_owned` (Boolean) Whether the object is managed by an external system. Available options are: true, false. Default value is true.
- `phone_number` (String) Phone number associated with the device. Required when the 'device_Type' is TEXT_PAGER, TEXT_PHONE, VOICE, VOICE_IVR. Voice/SMS phone numbers must be in in E.164 format, and include the + sign and country code. For example: +441632960577
- `pin` (String) The PIN code of the pager. Required when the 'device_Type' is TEXT_PAGER.
- `status` (String) Status of the device in xMatters. Available options are: ACTIVE, INACTIVE. Default is ACTIVE.
- `two_way_device` (Boolean) Required when the 'device_Type' is TEXT_PAGER. If 'true', the pager is able to send and receive messages. If 'false', the pager is only able to receive messages.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the xMatters device.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `target_name` (String) Device ID in xMatters consisting of owner’s target name, followed by the | (pipe) character, followed by the device name. For example, ‘mmcbride|Work Phone’.

<a id="nestedatt--timeframes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeframes`

Required:

- `days` (Set of String) List of the days of the week this timeframe is active. Available values are: SU, MO, TU, WE, TH, FR, SA.
- `duration_in_minutes` (Number) The length of the timeframe in minutes.
- `exclude_holidays` (Boolean) If ‘true’, the timeframe is excluded from site holidays; i.e., the device is not active on holidays.
- `name` (String) The name of the timeframe.
- `start_time` (String) The time of day that the timeframe begins. For example, 08:00, 15:30.
